  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN oc.customer_unique_id END) AS clientes_unicos_entregues
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_customers oc ON oc.customer_id = o.customer_id

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre o ticket médio por pedido (valor médio do pedido, somando o preço dos itens de cada pedido) considerando só pedidos entregues (status delivered) em 2018.
motivo_ex: nenhuma coluna gerada tem os valores de 'ticket_medio'
sql_gerado:
WITH itens AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, oi.price, p.category_name
  FROM olist.orders o
  INNER JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.purchased_at >= {{start_date}}::date
    AND o.purchased_at < ({{end_date}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
),
valor_pedido AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS valor_total
  FROM itens
  WHERE COALESCE(CARDINALITY({{categories}}::text[]), 0) = 0 OR category_name = ANY({{categories}}::text[])
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(valor_total), 0) AS ticket_medio
FROM valor_pedido

        date_trunc('month', delivered_to_customer_at)::date AS month_start,

    FROM olist.orders

      AND delivered_to_customer_at >= TIMESTAMP '2016-11-01 00:00:00'

    GROUP BY 1

with_moving_average AS (

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre as 10 categorias de produto com maior faturamento (soma do preço dos itens), usando o nome da categoria em inglês.
sql_gerado:
SELECT
  COALESCE(c.category_name_english, p.category_name) AS category_name_en,
  SUM(oi.price)::numeric(18,2) AS revenue
FROM olist.order_items oi
INNER JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN olist.categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_name
WHERE p.category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.category_name_english, p.category_name)
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', o.purchased_at) AS mes,
    SUM(i.price) AS faturamento
  FROM olist.orders o
  JOIN olist.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.purchased_at >= DATE '2017-01-01'
    AND o.purchased_at < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
com_anterior AS (
  SELECT
    mes,
    faturamento,
    LAG(faturamento) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS faturamento_anterior
  FROM mensal
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(mes, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
  faturamento,
  faturamento_anterior,
  ROUND(((faturamento - faturamento_anterior) / NULLIF(faturamento_anterior, 0)) * 100, 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM com_anterior
WHERE mes >= DATE '2017-02-01'
ORDER BY mes

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre as 10 categorias de produto com maior faturamento (soma do preço dos itens), usando o nome da categoria em inglês.

JOIN olist.categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_name
WHERE c.category_name_english IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.category_name_english
ORDER BY faturamento DESC
LIMIT 10

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre o faturamento (soma do preço dos itens) por estado do cliente, considerando só os 10 estados com maior faturamento.
sql_gerado:
WITH vendas_filtradas AS (
  SELECT
    oi.price,
    oc.city_id
  FROM olist.orders o
  INNER JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN olist.order_customers oc ON oc.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.purchased_at >= {{start_date}}::timestamp
    AND o.purchased_at < ({{end_date}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
)
SELECT
  c.state_code AS estado,
  SUM(vf.price)::numeric AS valor_vendido
FROM vendas_filtradas vf
INNER JOIN olist.cities c ON c.city_id = vf.city_id
GROUP BY c.state_code
ORDER BY valor_vendido DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  op.payment_type AS tipo_pagamento,
  SUM(op.payment_value) AS valor_total_pago,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(op.payment_value)
    / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(op.payment_value)) OVER (), 0),
    2
  ) AS participacao_percentual
FROM olist.order_payments AS op
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY participacao_percentual DESC, tipo_pagamento

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre as 10 categorias de produto com melhor nota média das avaliações (nome em inglês), considerando só categorias com pelo menos 500 avaliações de pedidos.
motivo_ex: nenhuma coluna gerada tem os valores de 'categoria'
sql_gerado:
WITH review_by_category AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.category_name_english AS category_name_english,
    rv.review_id,
    rv.review_score
  FROM olist.order_items oi
  JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN olist.categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_name
  JOIN olist.order_reviews ore ON ore.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist.reviews rv ON rv.review_id = ore.review_id
  WHERE c.category_name_english IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  category_name_english,
  ROUND(AVG(review_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_review_score,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM review_by_category
GROUP BY category_name_english
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY AVG(review_score) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: liste os 50 clientes (id único do cliente) que fizeram 3 ou mais pedidos entregues (status delivered) e mais gastaram (soma do preço dos itens): id do cliente, número de pedidos, gasto total, data da primeira e da última compra. Em caso de empate no gasto, ordene pelo id do cliente.
sql_gerado:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT oc.customer_unique_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.purchased_at
    FROM olist.orders o
    JOIN olist.order_customers oc ON oc.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT d.customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS num_pedidos,
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0) AS gasto_total,
           MIN(d.purchased_at) AS primeira_compra,
           MAX(d.purchased_at) AS ultima_compra
    FROM delivered_orders d
    LEFT JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       num_pedidos,
       gasto_total,
       primeira_compra,
       ultima_compra
FROM customer_agg
WHERE num_pedidos >= 3
ORDER BY gasto_total DESC, customer_unique_id
LIMIT 50

pedido: Adicione ao dashboard: mostre o ticket médio por pedido (valor médio do pedido, somando o preço dos itens de cada pedido) considerando só pedidos entregues (status delivered) em 2018.
motivo_ex: nenhuma coluna gerada tem os valores de 'ticket_medio'
sql_gerado:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS order_total
  FROM olist.orders o
  INNER JOIN olist.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.purchased_at >= DATE '2018-01-01'
    AND o.purchased_at < DATE '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT AVG(order_total) AS ticket_medio
FROM order_totals

ORDER BY mes

WITH review_categoria AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.category_name,
        ore.review_id,
        r.review_score
    FROM olist.order_items oi
    JOIN olist.order_reviews ore ON ore.order_id = oi.order_id

Em caso de empate no gasto, ordene pelo id do cliente.
sql_gerado:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.purchased_at
    FROM olist.orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oc.customer_id, oc.customer_unique_id
    FROM olist.order_customers oc
)
SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id AS cliente_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS num_pedidos,
    SUM(i.price) AS gasto_total,
    MIN(d.purchased_at) AS primeira_compra,
    MAX(d.purchased_at) AS ultima_compra
FROM delivered d
JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
JOIN olist.order_items i ON i.order_id = d.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) >= 3
ORDER BY gasto_total DESC, cliente_id ASC
LIMIT 50
